name: TestFlight elected, conditions unreadable
description: TestFlight won the election and the app cannot read a single part's condition from it. This is not hypothetical: it is the state the shipped GonogoTestFlightUplink.dll was permanently in until 2026-08-29, because its reflection layer bound three method names that exist in no TestFlight assembly and substituted a default for each miss. The wire said 'modelled, all nominal, worst engine 100%' for every craft on every install, at a priority that outranked Kerbalism. Coverage stays 'modeled' here on purpose: conditions being unreadable is a per-part fact, not a statement that nothing is being modelled, and the parts say so themselves.
